name: RKD Agri & Retail Limited
about: RKD Agri & Retail Limited engages in the retail and wholesale trade of printing and stationery, and bags products in India. It is also involved in agriculture and allied activities. The company was formerly known as Himalchuli Food Products Limited and changed its name to RKD Agri & Retail Limited in September 2020. RKD Agri & Retail Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
